references.text: The expression 'take a census' (שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ) is used here in the same way as for the census of Israel, where Moses and Aaron were to count the people.
Earlier in the same chapter, the spoils and captives are brought to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the congregation of Israel.
The following verse explains how the spoils were to be divided between the warriors and the rest of the congregation.
Moses is commanded to take a census (שָׂא אֵת רֹאשׁ), using the same language for conducting an official count.
Eleazar, Aaron's son, is mentioned as a priest with administrative responsibility, corresponding to his role here.
Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the tribes are mentioned together as leaders with authority over Israel.
The heads of the fathers' houses in Israel (רָאשֵׁי אֲבוֹת) are mentioned as leaders with authority, corresponding to the role here.
